Hi Samir — no problem, thanks for the note and the screenshot. 401 usually means the API key either isn't set on the request or the key hasn't been activated on the trial account yet. Two quick things before we rebook: 

1) Can you confirm which key you're using (the short id visible in the dashboard)?
2) Do you see a new key listed under Account > API Keys in the trial console?

If you prefer, we can do a short troubleshooting call (15–20m) tomorrow and we can get you past the 401 quickly. Proposed slots (PT):
- Thu 7/30 — 2:00 PM
- Thu 7/30 — 3:30 PM
- Fri 7/31 — 10:30 AM

If any of those work reply with the slot and I'll send a calendar update. I'm attaching the SDK quickstart in case your team wants to pre-install; it includes the minimal curl/node/python snippets and common token pitfalls.

Thanks,

Looping in in case you'd like a backend pairing session — I can join the call and help reproduce the 401 from our side. Quick preflight checklist if you want to try before we meet: 
- Confirm header Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_KEY> (no extra quotes)
- Ensure you're calling https://api.redwood.inference/v1/keys with the right environment (trial vs prod)
- Confirm IP allowlist if you enabled it in the console

If any of those are a no, ping me and I'll validate on the account. I'm available at 3:30 PM PT today for a short pairing session.
